## Decisions

- `Filing.locked`: `if deletion_locked -> True`. `if _payment_token exists (not only just added in history) or colin_event_ids exist -> True`. Otherwise False.
- `filing_date`, `payment_status_code`, `payment_token` setters: `if locked -> default lock exception`.
- `payment_completion_date` setter: `if locked or (_payment_token and _filing_json)` it sets the value. Otherwise `BusinessException('Payment Dates cannot set for unlocked filings unless the filing hasn't been saved yet.', 403)`.
- `status` getter: `if _status == COMPLETED and parent_filing_id and parent_filing._status == COMPLETED -> 'CORRECTED'`. Otherwise `_status`.
- `source` setter: `if source not in [x.value for x in Source] -> BusinessException('Tried to update the filing with an invalid source.', 400)`.

- Step 6 above, in `pay_filer.py`, treats an unknown payment token as OK only when the event has no filing identifier and its corp type is "BC". Every other unknown token gets 404.
- `filing.filing_type in ["continuationIn"] -> create_staff_review(filing)`; else `publish_to_filer(filing, payment_token)`. A `continuationIn` filing never reaches the filer from this service.
  - `create_staff_review` sets `review.status = ReviewStatus.AWAITING_REVIEW` and `filing.status = Filing.Status.AWAITING_REVIEW.value`.
- Before either branch, the handler sets `payment_completion_date = now(UTC)`, `payment_status_code = "COMPLETED"` and `status = Filing.Status.PAID`, then saves.

- `GET /api/v2/internal/filings/future_effective` (system role): returns ids from `Filing.get_future_effective_filing_ids()`.
  - A filing PENDING becomes PAID once `payment_completion_date` is set. Its id is listed only once its `effective_date` has passed. If time is set back before `effective_date`, the list is empty.
- `POST /api/v2/internal/bnmove` (system role): `if not oldBn or not newBn -> 400`. This covers `{}`, only `oldBn` and only `newBn`.
  - Success sets `business.tax_id = newBn`.

- In the PAD, PADR and PAYR path, any status other than `Fully PAID` marks the payment `FAILED`, including `PARTIAL`. The `PARTIAL` branch only changes `paid_amount`.
- Zero-amount rows are skipped unless the type is PAD, PADR or PAYR.
- The `JD` handlers act only on C+DISBURSEMENT and D+PAYMENT lines. Other combinations of flag and file type are ignored.
- The `.lower()` comparison on `Status` values makes the match case-insensitive.
- The same identifier update arriving twice is harmless, because the second run finds no invoices under the old identifier.
- The same CGI JD line arriving twice would add to the receipt twice, because there is no duplicate-receipt check. The `feedback_file_ref` guard prevents this only at file level.
